parameters.name: IpsecServerId
parameters.description: The ID of the IPsec server.

parameters.name: IpsecServerName
parameters.description:
The name of the IPsec server.

The name must be 1 to 100 characters in length.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: **1** to **20**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

*   If this is your first request and no next requests are to be performed, you do not need to specify this parameter.
*   You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of **NextToken**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region where the IPsec server is created.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource group to which the IPsec server belongs.

The IPsec server and its associated VPN gateway belong to the same resource group. You can call [DescribeVpnGateway](~~2794055~~) to query the ID of the resource group to which the VPN gateway belongs.

parameters.name: VpnGatewayId
parameters.description: The ID of the VPN gateway.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc list-ipsec-servers --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ipsec-server-name test --vpn-gateway-id vpn-bp1q8bgx4xnkm2ogj0000 --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a0000 --max-results 10 --ipsec-server-id iss-bp1bo3xuvcxo7ixll0000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmzs372yg0000 --region cn-hangzhou
